name: Vault Flooded Gallery
player_description: The right passage descends sharply and the floor is underwater -- two inches, then six, then knee-deep by the far end. Torchlight reflects off the black water. Something moves at the edge of the light.
gm_notes: 4 Shadows. The preserved Germanic warrior in the far alcove (DC 12 Medicine: he has been dead for decades but shows no decay -- the water has something to do with it). His framea lies beside him. Second contract token is tied to his belt. Entering the water: DC 10 CON save or gain one Exhaustion level from cold (campaign cold mechanic).
